testResults.name: market-lake-adapter
testResults.result: 7 tests passed for ensure/poll/load ordering, API-issued SAS URL consumption, XNYS half-day resolution, two-symbol loading, incomplete coverage rejection, unsupported assets, request validation, and projected egress warnings.

testResults.name: published-client-boundary
testResults.result: The adapter composes the published lakeclient contract and does not import Alpaca, duplicate HTTP, create storage credentials, or access wall-clock time in the synchronous boundary.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed.

decisions: Every requested symbol is ensured before file queries run, and all canonical sessions and API-issued read URLs are validated before the reader is called.
Market-lake requests support equity XNYS sessions and crypto UTC days; option data remains explicitly unsupported by this adapter.
